results.note: Looking up into a leafy crown with many small red-brown seed balls hanging in strings; the balls and their chains read, but each ball is small in the frame and competes with the leaves and branches. View from below.
A tall trunk in woodland with grey-brown bark and pale flaking patches; trunk edges show and the patch pattern repeats.
Several mottled white trunks of a multi-stemmed tree in winter, seen from a distance; the patchy peeling pattern shows but needs close study at this size.

An old gnarled trunk and roots growing against a rock overhang, with a seedling in front; deep shade and dappled sun change the colour, and the weathered trunk does not show the typical mottled plates.
New spring shoot with expanding yellow-green palmately lobed leaves and red flower heads on a stalk; the leaves have not reached full size or colour.
A street scene lined with trees and parked cars; no leaf, bark, or fruit is the subject.
Brown, blighted and curled leaves on a twig among green foliage, with one seed ball; the subject leaves are dead or diseased, and the browning and curling distort the outline.
A massive smooth white trunk with darker patches, measured with a tape while people stand beside it; branch shadows lie across the bark.
Looking up into a bare winter crown with white branches and many small hanging seed balls against blue sky; the crown is the subject.
An urban street scene with a pink-flowering tree, palms, and a van; no part of the named tree is the subject.
A whole leafy tree in a garden among other plants; the leaves blend into a crown mass.
Two red pistillate flower heads with curled styles on a hairy stalk against a dark background; these are flowers, not the mature seed balls.
A whole bare white-branched tree beside a path among evergreens; the tree form is the subject.
A motion-blurred roadside scene of riparian trees taken through a car window with reflections; no part is readable.
A smooth trunk with grey, white, and pale blue-green mottled patches, edges visible; a few leafy sprays sit in front but do not hide the bark.
A hanging bee swarm in a leafy tree in a backyard; the swarm, not the tree part, is the subject.
A scene of a fallen and broken tree among shrubs and other trees; no part is the subject.
A whole slender bare tree on a green hillside under grey sky; the tree form is the subject.
A dim view of bare white branches in a winter crown against dark woods; the crown is the subject and the light is flat and dark.
A whole broad tree with a white trunk and a crown of fresh leaves in a meadow; the leaves blend into a mass.
A whole multi-stemmed tree in leaf against hillside vegetation; no single leaf, bark area or fruit is the subject, so the part is other.
A trunk with a long open cavity, among busy foliage and another trunk in the foreground. The grey surface is readable, but the cavity breaks up the bark pattern (damaged), so the pattern needs study.
A park scene with several young trees, a fence and a gate; no leaf, bark or fruit is the subject.
A campus lawn scene framed by sycamore limbs, in autumn colour and low evening light; no single part is the subject.
A landscape of hills and scrub; any sycamores are small and far away, so the part is other.
A view from below up a trunk into a backlit crown beside a rock face; the main subject is the crown and scene.
A garden sign that reads Aliso, Western Sycamore, Platanus racemosa; no part of the tree shows, and the readable name label gives the answer away.
A massive old trunk with flaky plated bark, framed by foliage, a road sign and a white marker in front; the bark is readable but other objects compete.
One deeply lobed, palmately veined leaf from the underside, against a soft background; the long stalk runs to the twig but the join is hard to see, and no scale object shows.
A view from below into a dense crown, with a pale trunk partly hidden by leaves; the main subject is the crown mass.
A woodland scene with a pale-limbed tree among other trees and shrubs; no single part is the subject.
A whole multi-stemmed tree with white limbs and yellowing autumn leaves against blue sky; the part is other.
The base of a multi-stemmed trunk with a charred hollow; the mottled grey-white bark shows, but from a distance, and the burned cavity breaks up the surface (damaged).
A grey trunk split by a long dark cavity, with busy undergrowth and other trunks around it; the surface reads, but the cavity interrupts the pattern (damaged).
The camera looks up a smooth, mottled white trunk into the leafy crown (angle), so the bark check for an upward view applies.
Dark branches and scattered yellow autumn leaves seen from below against the sky; the main subject is the crown.
Several overlapping lobed leaves from above, with brown dead leaves and spots around them; the leaves crowd and overlap (alone and whole false), and brown patches damage some blades.
Pale mottled limbs and a crown of green leaves seen from below against the sky; no single part is the subject.
A cluster of lobed, toothed leaves from above, against a soft background; the central leaf shows whole, but several leaves overlap and crowd it.
A bird perched on a branch among young, backlit spring leaves; the bird is the main subject, so the part is other. A photographer credit shows, but it is not a plant name label.
A fisheye panorama of a courtyard with buildings; the tree is only a canopy overhead in a scene. No leaf, bark, or fruit is the subject, and the distortion is an unusual angle.
A view up into the crown against the sky, with many leaves and small seed balls; the leaves on the right blend into a mass. Backlit, viewed from below, with autumn-coloured leaves.
A thicket of branches and trunks with many small leaves that blend into a mass; no single leaf can be read.
A whole small tree against a blue sky, seen from below; the main subject is the crown, not one part.
A sapling with fresh light-green leaves among leafless shrubs; the leaves blend into a mass and are small in the frame.
Four spiky seed balls on one stalk hang from the twig among yellowing leaves; the kind, shape, and hang read clearly.
The camera looks up the trunk into the crown; the lower trunk shows rough plated bark, but the crown fills most of the frame. Backlit from the sky.
One deeply lobed leaf with narrow pointed lobes is in full view in the centre, with other leaves around it competing. Strong sun and shade patches change the colour.
Several mottled autumn leaves in a crowded frame with branches and a trunk; the lobed outlines read, the margin needs close study.
A large palmately lobed leaf in front shows in full with clear veins and toothed lobes, but many other leaves crowd the frame. Both upper and under sides show among the leaves.
Several chains of spiky seed balls hang from twigs below the leaves against a pale sky; kind, shape, and hang read clearly.
A whole tall tree on a street corner against a blue sky; the subject is the whole tree, not one part.
Bare twigs of a young tree with small emerging or curled leaves against an overcast sky; no leaf, bark, or fruit can be read. Flat backlight from the grey sky.
A small sapling on a rocky slope with many small leaves that blend into a mass; harsh sun washes out the colour.
A whole, mostly leafless tree with pale trunks beside other vegetation; the subject is the whole tree.
A whole tree with white mottled trunks and a sparse crown against a blue sky; the subject is the whole tree.
Many overlapping autumn-tinged leaves fill the frame and the photo is soft, though the lobed edges can be traced; no single leaf stands alone.
A chain of five spiky seed balls hangs from the twig in front of a leaf, with a soft parking-lot background; kind, shape, and hang read clearly.
Fresh light-green spring leaves crowd a sapling, with old seed balls near the trunk; the leaves are small in the frame and not yet full grown.
A whole wind-swept tree in a dry wash against a blue sky; the subject is the whole tree, not one part.
Trunk section with both edges in frame, showing the mottled flaking patches of grey, cream, and brown against a sky background.

Black-and-white herbarium mount of line drawings of Oregon ash and California sycamore. The typed label names both species. The sycamore leaf is small in the frame, and the ash drawing competes with it.
Close view of cracked, flaking bark plates with a trunk edge at the right. Dappled sun and shade change the colour, so colour is search and light is a cause.
Close-up of mottled bark with peeling brown plates over cream and tan patches. There is no trunk edge or scale object, so it is too close.
Trunk with clear camouflage patches of white, grey, and tan, plus a peeling flake. Both trunk edges show.
Leaning trunk seen from a few metres away. Strong dappled leaf shadows break up the mottled pattern, and the bark is small in the frame, so the features are search and light is a cause.
A chain of five dry, brown seed balls hangs on one stalk against the sky and soft trees. One upper ball has started to shed a little.
Colour botanical plate of palmately lobed leaves with hanging seed balls. The caption 'Platanus racemosa' and 'California Buttonwood' is readable and gives the answer away.
Whole tree with a massive smooth grey trunk and spreading limbs in a park. The main subject is the whole tree, not one part.
Whole tree with a full green crown above a path. No single leaf, bark, or fruit feature is the subject.
A chain of green-yellow spiky seed balls hangs from a stalk among leaves. The balls have full shape but are not ripe, and the leaves around them compete.
Twin-stemmed trunk with a gnarled, mossy base in a busy woodland scene. The bark is seen from a distance, so texture and pattern are search.
View up into the crown against the sky. Backlit leaves and fruit balls blend into a mass, and no single leaf stands out.
Several brown and green seed balls hang on long stalks among leaves, with a rocky background. Many balls and leaves compete, so alone is false.
The main subject is the pale succulent rosettes that grow on a mossy, rough limb. The sycamore bark is only the background.
Close-up of grey, tan, and cream bark plates with cracks between them. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale.
Green spiky seed balls hang on stalks from the twig among lobed leaves. They have full shape but are not ripe, and the leaves compete.
Trunk with smooth mottled bark and a rough, pitted patch, against leaves and sky. Warm low sun tints the bark, so colour is search and light is a cause.
Smooth, pale, white-grey trunk with faint mottling and dark burls, with both trunk edges in frame.

A chain of four fuzzy yellow-green young fruit heads, still bristly with styles, hangs on one stalk against a soft yard background. They have not reached the mature seed-ball look, so young is a cause.

Mottled white, grey and tan peeling bark on large forking limbs, shot looking up into the crown against blue sky with leaves and twigs around it. The camera looks up into the crown (bark_up_or_dark), the view from below is an angle cause, and strong sun bleaches the pale patches (light).

New, bright green palmately lobed leaves seen from below against the sky, with a chain of old dried seed balls hanging below and a tangle of bare twigs around them. The leaves overlap and are backlit, so outline and edge need close study. They are young and not yet full size, and the view from below is an angle cause.
Whole small tree with a dense blue-green crown in a field beside a house; no single leaf, bark, or fruit is the subject, so part is other.
Whole single-trunk tree in a lawn beside a stone wall, green summer crown; part is other.
Whole young tree with a green crown; the crown top reaches the frame edge, so whole is false. Part is other.

Close view of yellow male catkins and bud scales on a twig, with leaves only around the frame; flowers are the main subject, so part is other and the catkins take the place of a leaf or fruit feature.
Trunk fork with lichen-spotted, scaly grey-brown bark, shot looking up into the crown against sky and leaves; the upward view is a reject and makes the plate pattern hard to read.
Hanging yellow-green male catkins with pinkish unfolding young leaves on a twig against a soft background; catkins are the main subject, so part is other.
Trunk and limbs seen from below looking up into a green crown against blue sky; the upward view is a reject and the scaly bark pattern is small and far.

Oblong, shallowly lobed grey-green leaves with a small catkin cluster, seen from below against bright sky; the central leaf is whole, but catkins and other leaves compete, and the view from below with backlight changes the look.
Many hanging yellow male catkins with small pink unfolding leaves on twigs; catkins are the main subject, so part is other.
Upright green shoot with pinkish, downy, half-unfolded young leaves against a plain soft background; the leaves are young and folded or tilted edge-on, so the lobed outline needs close study.
Woodland scene with a twisted trunk and spreading green crown among other trees; part is other, the tree is not shown in full and competes with surrounding vegetation.

Branch with oblong, shallowly lobed grey-green leaves and small catkins, seen partly from below; several whole leaves are readable, but the leaves crowd each other and the catkins and many tilted leaves compete.
Lower trunk and green crown of a tree on rocky ground by a wall; the crown is cut off by the frame top and other stems compete. Part is other.
Close view of yellow male catkins and brown bud scales with leaves in the background; flowers are the main subject, so part is other.
Dense cluster of oblong, shallowly lobed grey-green leaves on reddish twigs; outlines are traceable, but the leaves crowd each other and the margin lobing is small in the frame.
Shoot of young reddish-orange lobed leaves against a dark soft background; the leaves are young and strong backlight changes their colour, though the shallow lobes are readable.
Close view of a dense mass of blue-grey, mostly three-lobed leaves; the leaves overlap and are small in the frame, so the outline and edge of one leaf need a search.

Branch of green, shallowly to moderately lobed leaves against a yellow-brown autumn background, with a few yellowing leaves and one dead leaf at the edge; the lobed outlines read well but many leaves overlap.
Whole tree with a dense green crown and short trunk in a grassy clearing; the crown reaches the frame top, so whole is false. Part is other.
Section of a crown with many oblong blue-green leaves and a trunk behind; leaves overlap and are dark against bright sky, so single outlines and edges need a search.
Twig of entire oblong leaves with small young acorns among a crowded, dim background of more leaves. Crowding and the dark, shaded film tone put shape and margin at search, and the shade gives light.

Twig seen from below with the pale undersides of oblong entire leaves, and a finger at the left edge. Leaves overlap, are tilted, and the frame cuts them, so shape is search, whole is false, and angle applies.
Crowded leafy twig, some leaves shallowly lobed, with a cluster of acorns half hidden in the centre. The leaves crowd one another, so shape and margin are at search and alone is false.
Rosette of shallowly lobed oblong leaves at a twig tip, the centre leaves readable, among dark crowded leaves. The film is dark with a cool cast from shade, so light applies and alone is false.
Many small entire grey-green leaves on twigs filling the frame. Each leaf is small and crowded, so shape and margin are at search and alone is false.
A leafy branch seen from below against sky and a building. Leaves are small in the frame and backlit, so shape and margin are at search, with angle and light as causes.
Lobed blue-green leaves, the centre leaf whole and sharp, among other overlapping leaves. Shape and margin read clearly; the crowding of neighbouring leaves makes alone false.
Twig with buds and oblong entire leaves shown from beneath, tilted, over a soft lawn. The frame cuts the leaves and they are tilted, so whole is false, shape is search, and angle applies.
Close view of green oblong acorns in scaly cups among leaves. The acorns are full shape but green, so growth_stage is unripe; the attachment to the twig is only partly visible.
A crown seen from below against blue sky with the sun in frame. The main subject is the crown, so part is other; the upward view and backlight are causes.

Crowded leafy branches with entire oblong leaves, a few catkins, and a trunk at right. Leaves overlap and compete, so shape and margin are at search and alone is false; catkins mark spring but do not replace the leaves.

Twig with an acorn and several leaves, the upper oblong leaf whole and sharp, others shallowly lobed against a dark background. Harsh light casts deep shadows across the leaves, so light applies; neighbouring leaves make alone false.
Canopy seen from below against sky and a building, leaves dark against the light. The subject is the canopy rather than a leaf, so part is other; the upward view and backlight are causes.
Twig with buds and oblong entire leaves seen from below over a soft lawn. Leaves are tilted and cut by the frame, so whole is false, shape is search, and angle applies.
Full trunk with both edges, covered in small grey blocky plates, on rocky ground. The pattern repeat and colour read clearly.
Spring twig with hanging catkins and small reddish unfolding leaves on a soft background. The main subject is the flowering shoot, so part is other.
Green oblong acorns in scaly cups among large leaves on a twig. The leaves crowd around and partly cover the acorns, so alone is false; the acorns are full shape but green, so unripe.
Trunk with small blocky plates and its right edge in view. Harsh side light and a deep shadow on the left change the colour, so light applies and colour is at search.
Small trunk with both edges, scaly flaking grey plates, over a lawn. A lichen-covered wound scar in the centre interrupts the pattern, so damaged applies.
A dense mass of shallowly lobed leaves in orange and rust autumn colour. Crowding puts shape and margin at search and alone false; autumn colour sets growth_stage autumn and usual_look false.

Crowded spray of entire, oblong leaves with a catkin cluster in the centre; overlapping leaves and cut tips put the outline at search and no single leaf shows in full. Catkins sit beside the leaves rather than replacing them.
Whole small tree on a rocky slope; no single leaf, bark or fruit is the subject.
Grey trunk with small blocky, scaly plates, both trunk edges in frame; texture and pattern read clearly.
Hand holds a twig of shallow-lobed leaves with a round gall; several leaves crowd the frame so alone is false. A leaf-miner blotch on the lower leaf does not change its outline.
Hand holds a twig with lobed leaves and a cluster of pale round galls; the galls and surrounding leaves compete for attention, so alone is false.
Hand behind a cluster of shallow-lobed leaves; the top leaf shows a whole outline. Strong direct sun with hard shadows changes the leaf colour, and the leaves crowd each other.
Woodland scene with a leaning trunk and crown foliage; no single part is the subject.
Crowded entire leaves seen from below against the sky with an acorn on the twig; the view from below and backlight change the colour, and overlapping leaves put the outline at search.
One entire, oblong leaf underside held against a soft background; the fingers cover the leaf base, so whole is false.
Young acorn seen from the top, mostly cup with only the nut tip showing; it has not reached full shape and the top view hides the acorn outline, so kind and shape are at search.
Underside of one oblong, wavy-edged leaf held by hand; the thumb covers the leaf base, so whole is false.
Forked trunk and limbs with blocky grey bark among foliage; bark seen from a distance, so texture and pattern are at search.
Spring shoot of entire leaves with hanging catkins; backlight turns several leaves yellow, and crowded overlapping leaves put the outline at search.
Several acorns, green and brown, with warty cups on the twig among leaves; the leaves and an object at right compete, so alone is false.
Dense mass of shallow-lobed leaves; several individual leaves still read clearly, but crowding makes alone false.
Small branch fork with flaky reddish-brown bark surrounded by foliage; the bark is small and seen from a distance, so texture and pattern are at search.
Twig with alternate entire, oblong leaves against a dark background; other leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false.
One large shallow-lobed leaf seen from below, backlit and slightly soft; edges are traceable so features are at search, and the top of the leaf is cut by other leaves and the frame.
Whole tree crown above shrubs; no single part is the subject.
Catkins and a new shoot in the centre with entire leaves around them; the frame cuts the leaves and the catkins compete, so whole and alone are false and the outline is at search.
One green full-size acorn with a scaly cap, still on its twig, held in front of a hand. Not yet ripe, so unripe and not the usual look.
A sunlit branch section with many small green acorns scattered among crowded leaves. The acorns are small in the frame and compete with the foliage, so kind and shape need a search; they are unripe.
Crowded, wet, shallowly lobed green leaves; the large lower-right leaf shows its whole outline. Crowding makes alone false; small spots do not change the outlines.
Close view of one wet green acorn with a warty cap, sitting among leaves. The attachment to the twig is partly hidden, so hang is search; the acorn is full shape but unripe.

A leafy twig of grey-green, shallowly lobed leaves with small clusters of young fruit; the lower-right leaf is whole. Leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false; some brown patches do not change the outlines.
A cluster of elongated green acorns with shallow caps in the centre, surrounded by busy lobed leaves. Leaves compete, so alone is false; the acorns are unripe.
A sunny branch scene with small green acorns scattered among many leaves. The acorns are small in the frame and compete with foliage, so the key features need a search; they are unripe.
Several green acorns with warty caps fill the centre, with the stalks on the twig visible. Full shape but unripe.
A cluster of blue-green, shallowly lobed leaves at a twig tip against a soft background; the lower leaves show whole outlines. Warm low sun and shade shift the colour, so light is a cause.
A grey trunk with small blocky plates and both trunk edges in the frame, against a soft woodland background. The pattern repeat reads clearly.
View up into the trunk and crown of a tree, with leafy branches across the frame. Part is other. The upward view gives angle, and the crown runs off the frame.
Park scene with a whole tree, Spanish moss and a palm at its base. Part is other. The strong sun flare backlights the crown (light).
One green lobed leaf, upper side, against a soft background. The tip just reaches the top edge. The stalk joins the twig at the bottom, but the arrangement needs close study.
Tiny young acorns sit on a green twig against a soft background. They are young: the nut barely shows from the cup, so the acorn kind and shape need close study.
Close bark with blocky plates and deep vertical fissures. No trunk edge or scale shows, so it is too close.
Grey trunk with small scaly plates and shallow fissures. Both trunk edges show.
View from below into a backlit crown, with Spanish moss. The leaves blend into a mass (leaf_mass). The upward view and the backlight give angle and light.
A lobed leaf on a twig, with its stalk joining the stem, so the arrangement shows. Other leaves above and below it compete, so alone is false.
Two whole lobed leaves on black, one upper side and one underside. Small brown spots do not change the outline.
Close detail of parts of two leaves on black, showing the venation and surface. The leaf outline is not shown, so shape is no (feature_unclear). Only a short stretch of the edge shows.
A whole lobed leaf hangs at the centre with its pale underside showing. Neighbouring leaves crowd both sides (alone false). The stalk join at the top needs close study.
Grey trunk with small blocky plates, both edges in frame, against a soft background.
Twig with lateral buds and leaf stalks on black. Its main subject is a twig with buds, so the part is other.
Close view of the pale underside of a lobed leaf. The frame cuts off the top and the stalk, so whole is false and the shape needs study. A second leaf at the right competes.
Leafy branches against a bright sky, seen from below, possibly with a few acorns. The leaves blend into a mass (leaf_mass). The upward view and the backlight give angle and light.
Two whole leaves on black: a lobed leaf with its upper side up, and an unlobed leaf with its underside up. Reddish spots do not change the outline.
Park scene with a tall tree among others, a park sign and a shelter. Part is other. The sign is a park sign, not a plant name label.
A full-size green acorn with its scaly cup, still attached to the twig, on black. It is not ripe, so the growth stage is unripe and usual_look is false.
Close view of a cluster of terminal buds and leaf stalks on a twig, on black. Its main subject is a twig with buds, so the part is other.
A whole lobed leaf stands upright at the centre on a twig. Other leaves crowd both sides (alone false). The stalk join at the twig is only partly seen.

One large shallow-lobed leaf held toward the camera, with a trunk and woodland behind it. The left frame edge cuts off the leaf base, a second leaf overlaps the lower part, and the leaf is tilted to the camera.

A cluster of obovate leaves, mostly unlobed, on a twig in front of a trunk. The central leaf is whole, but the other leaves crowd it, and dappled sun flecks change its colour. The petiole joins are hard to see.
A trunk shown edge to edge, with light grey bark broken into small scaly blocks. One leaf crosses the trunk, but it does not hide the pattern.
A wet, brown, fallen lobed leaf lies in leaf litter. The subject is a dead leaf, so the photo is a reject.
Several shallow-lobed leaves on a twig in front of a trunk, with a hand at the bottom edge. The middle leaf is whole, but the leaves crowd each other, and the petiole joins are hard to see.
Two tiny developing acorns sit on a green twig, and their scaly cups almost hide the nuts. Because they are young, a learner must study the photo to read the acorn kind and shape.
A whole tall tree in summer leaf, with a person at the bottom right for scale. The main subject is the whole tree, so the part is other.
An acorn cut across, showing the green flesh inside the brown cup rim. The section is seen face on in flash light against a black background, so the kind and the outline are hard to read.
Seen from below, the crown branches stand against a white sky, with dark and red-brown leaves backlit. The image is soft and noisy, and the blur smears the leaf edges.
A hand holds a twig of obovate, mostly entire leaves in front of a trunk. The lower leaves are whole, but the cluster crowds them, and the petiole joins are hard to see.
The base of a large trunk, with both edges and the ground in view, and grey bark in long ridges and furrows. A thin vine crosses it, but it does not hide the pattern.
Seen from below, the crown branches stand against a white sky, with backlit dark and brown leaves. The image is soft and noisy, and the blur smears the leaf edges.
Seen from below, a sunlit crown of green leaves is strongly backlit. The main subject is the crown, so the part is other.
Seen from below, the edge of a crown stands as a dark silhouette against a cloudy sky. The main subject is the crown, so the part is other.
Three tiny developing acorns sit on a green twig, and their scaly cups almost hide the nuts. Because they are young, a learner must study the photo to read the acorn kind and shape.
Looking straight up a large trunk into a leafy crown, against a bright sky. The main subject is the tree from below, so the part is other.
A brown, fallen obovate leaf lies among other leaf litter. The subject is a dead leaf, so the photo is a reject.

A branch tip of many small lobed leaves, seen from below against a blue sky. The leaves crowd each other and are small in the frame, so a learner must study the photo to read the outline and the edge.
A trunk, with its left edge in view, has grey bark in small scaly plates and patches of pale lichen. The pattern repeat shows in full.
Looking up a trunk into a sparse crown with Spanish moss, against a bright sky. The main subject is the crown and branches, so the part is other.

Full mossy trunk seen from a distance in a shaded forest with patches of sun. The bark is far away and partly hidden by moss, so texture and pattern need study, and the dappled light changes the colour. It looks like the same image as h143.
Close, sharp view of a trunk with both edges in frame, showing narrow scaly ridges and furrows with some lichen and moss. Nothing makes it harder.
A pile of fallen dead brown leaves on soil beside a concrete curb. The subject is dead leaves (a reject), and they overlap, so the outline and margin of any one leaf are hard to pick out.
A trunk section with both edges in frame, showing shallow scaly ridges with moss and lichen. Leaves beside it do not compete with it.
A forest scene: a person on a stump reaches up toward a tree whose crown leaves the frame. No leaf, bark or fruit is the main subject, so the part is other.
Seven dried brown leaves on a white board with a ruler. The outlines are clear, but the subject is dead leaves (a reject), and the lamp light and shadow change the colour.
A crown seen from below against a bright sky, with the sun in the corner. The main subject is the crown, so the part is other. The view from below and the backlight make it harder.

A hand at the top holds up a long twig of narrow, shallow-lobed leaves against a busy forest floor. The leaves are small, tilted and crowded, and the frame cuts some off, so shape and margin need study.

Top view of a sapling shoot with a cluster of broad, shallow-lobed leaves at its tip, over a log and leaf litter. The margins are small in the frame, and other leaves at the edges compete. The shoot rises near a log, but nothing shows that it is a sucker.
A sapling with a whorl of shallow-lobed leaves at the shoot tip, between a log and a trunk. The margins are small in the frame, and surrounding foliage competes.
A hand holds a cluster of lobed leaves that join at the twig tip, in front of a trunk. The left leaf has holes that break its outline (damaged).

Full mossy trunk seen from a distance in deep forest shade with patches of sun. Texture and pattern need study because of the distance and the moss, and the dappled light changes the colour. It looks like the same image as h076.
Close view over fingers of three leaf bases where they join the twig. The wavy, lobed edges show, but the frame cuts off every leaf, so the outline can only be inferred.
One green lobed leaf held up in a hand against a soft forest background. The hand covers the base, so whole is false. A few tiny holes do not change the outline.
A hand holds a lobed leaf from a cluster. The frame edge cuts off the lower part of the leaf, and the surrounding leaves compete with it.
A whorl of long, shallow-lobed leaves at a twig tip over dark foliage. The shallow lobes need study, and holes and tears break the outline of some leaves (damaged).
Dark red seed balls hang on stalks among lobed green leaves against sky. The balls are small in the frame and the foliage crowds them, so kind and shape need a close look; the hang is easy to read.
Upright trunk of mottled, flaking grey-brown bark with a branch at the right and green undergrowth around it. The flaking plates and the trunk edges are readable.
Three pale mottled trunks seen from some distance on a grassy hillside. The patchy pattern shows, but the surface texture needs close study because of the distance.
A gnarled hollow trunk with exposed roots under a rock overhang, with a small green seedling in front. The main subject is the scene, and the bark detail is not readable.
New yellow-green lobed leaves on a twig, with spiky red flower balls hanging below that compete for attention. The leaves have not reached full shape, and the margin and venation need close study.
A street lined with tall green trees, cars and houses. The photo is a scene and no tree part is the subject.
The main subjects are dry, brown, curled leaves hanging on a twig, with green foliage crowding the background. The leaves are dead and their outlines are distorted.
A very large pale trunk with dark blotches, a yellow tape around it and two people beside it. Shadows stripe the trunk and change its colour, and the surface texture is small in the frame.
A bare crown seen from below with many small seed balls against blue sky. The main subject is the whole crown, not a single part.
A street scene with a pink flowering tree, palms, a van and buildings. No part of the named tree is the subject.
A whole leafy tree in a garden among palms and shrubs against blue sky. The subject is the whole tree.
Close view of two spiky red-maroon flower balls on a stalk against a dark background. These are flower heads only, with no leaf, bark or ripe fruit.
Whole bare pale-trunked trees beside a garden path with conifers behind. The photo is a scene of whole trees.
A blurred roadside scene shot through a car window with a guardrail and reflections. No tree part can be read.
A smooth trunk with pale blue-grey and cream flaking patches, with some green leaves and branches in front. The patchy pattern is readable and the trunk edges show.
A bee swarm hangs in leafy branches in a garden. The main subject is the swarm, not a tree part.
A wide scene with a fallen pale trunk on dry ground among shrubs and trees. The subject is the scene.
A whole bare tree with a pale trunk on a green hillside. The subject is the whole tree.
A dark, tangled mass of bare branches and pale trunks. The photo shows a stand of trees with no part in focus as the subject.
A whole tree with a pale base and a spreading crown that is beginning to leaf out, standing on grass. The subject is the whole tree.
A whole tree with pale trunks and green crown beside a path, in a scene with dense foliage around it. Main subject is the whole tree, so part is other.

A trunk seen from a few metres with a large split and dark cavity down the front, set among green undergrowth and other trunks. The surface pattern is hard to read at this distance and the split breaks it up, so texture and pattern need close study; damaged for the cavity.
A park scene with several small trees, a fence and a bench. The crowns carry white clusters that look like flowers, which is the sign for spring. No leaf, bark or fruit is the main subject.
A park lawn in autumn colour seen under a big pale branch in the foreground. The scene is the subject, with yellowing crowns and tiny distant people that give no usable scale.
A hillside landscape with oak branches framing the top and a few pale leafless trees in the middle distance against fresh green growth. No leaf, bark or fruit is the subject, so part is other.
A view up from below a leaning trunk and crown over a rock wall, with leaves backlit by the sky. The trunk is only a diagonal strip in a crown and scene view, so part is other.
A readable park sign that names Western Sycamore, Platanus racemosa, and describes its peeling bark. The plant name label is in the frame and gives the answer away, so it is a name_label reject.

A thick old trunk with deeply furrowed, corky, grey-tan bark, with foliage above, a white marker post and a sign in front, and a car behind. The file is small but sharp. The ridge pattern is readable only with some study, so pattern is search; the post competes with the trunk.

One large, sharp, green palmate leaf with pointed lobes and a toothed edge, against a soft background. A few dry brown leaves hang beside it. The stalk meets the twig only at the top edge, so arrangement is search.
A view up into a leafy crown with a pale trunk and branches seen through the leaves. The subject is the crown, so part is other.
A whole tree with a pale trunk inside a dense wooded scene, with foliage in the foreground. The tree does not stand out from its surroundings.
A whole multi-stemmed tree with white trunks and yellowing leaves against a deep blue sky. The colours are strongly saturated, but the tree still looks real, so I did not escalate.

A forked trunk with a hollow burnt or rotted cavity on a dry hillside, with a few leaves at the top. The grey mottled bark is seen from a distance, so texture and pattern are search; damaged for the cavity.

A trunk with a long dark vertical split, seen from a distance among tall grass and shrubs. The pale grey bark is smooth-looking but its pattern needs close study, and the split is the main feature; damaged for the cavity.

A pale blotchy trunk and fork seen from below, with the camera looking up into the green crown against the sky. The trunk is the main subject but the camera looks up into the crown, so it is a bark_up_or_dark reject.
A view up into a bare-looking crown with dark branches and scattered orange autumn leaves, backlit by blue sky. The subject is the crown, so part is other.

A tangle of overlapping green leaves with brown, tattered and dead leaves among them, on thin twigs. No single leaf outline can be traced without study, so shape and margin are search, and the leaves are crowded. damaged for the tears and browning.
A view up into a crown with pale branches and green leaves against the sky. The leaves blend into a crown view, so part is other.

A group of green pointed-lobed leaves with a toothed edge, one of them whole in the centre, with more leaves overlapping behind it. The leaves are crowded so alone is false. The twig joins are hard to see, so arrangement is search.

Bright yellow-green new lobed leaves around a bird sitting on a branch, with a photographer watermark in the corner. The bird competes with the leaves, so alone is false. The leaves are young and spring-new. The watermark is not a plant label.
Wide panoramic scene of a courtyard with buildings and a lawn under tree branches. No leaf, bark or fruit is the subject.

Branch tips seen from below against sky, with green and yellow-brown leaves and small hanging seed balls. The leaves are many and overlap; only a few outlines can be traced. Autumn colour, and the view from below is the angle.
Understory scene of trunks, branches and foliage in a tangle. No single leaf, bark area or fruit is the main subject.
Whole small tree with a pale trunk and a crown of leaves against a blue sky. Whole-tree photo, so part is other.
A sapling with fresh light-green leaves that blend into a mass. Individual lobed leaves are small in the frame and take close study to trace. Young leaves.
Four spiky seed balls on a curved stalk, sharp, with soft yellowing leaves behind. Kind, shape and how they hang are readable.
The camera looks up the trunk into the crown. Dark furrowed bark shows at the lower left but is foreshortened, and the crown and sky dominate the frame.
One green lobed leaf with a red petiole, centred and sharp, upper side. Other leaves overlap it and the background is busy, so alone is false.
Crowded lobed leaves mottled yellow, green and brown, beside a pale trunk, in flat light. Outlines overlap and the leaves are small in the frame, so features need a search. Autumn colour.
Large lobed leaves, with a pale one in the lower centre whose outline and edge are readable. The frame edge cuts off that leaf and others, and the leaves crowd each other. Both sides show.
Many spiky seed balls hanging on long stalks against soft sky, with dull leaves above. Kind, shape and hang are clear.
Whole tree on a street seen from below, with buildings and cars at the base. Whole-tree photo, so part is other.
A bare young tree with thin twigs, a few buds and some dead brown leaves under a grey sky. Buds and twigs only, so part is other.
A shrubby plant on a dry hillside with small yellow-green leaves. It is a scene with no single leaf, bark area or fruit as the subject. The source name matches the tree, so no mismatch.
A whole tree with a pale trunk and a mostly bare crown just leafing out, against blue sky. Whole-tree photo, so part is other.
A whole tree with white mottled trunks and a sparse grey-green crown on a hillside. Whole-tree photo, so part is other.
A soft, grainy mass of small green and yellow-brown leaves over branches. Edges are smeared, so the margin cannot be read and the leaves blend into a mass. Autumn colour.
Five brown spiky seed balls hanging in a string on one stalk in front of a large leaf, with a soft car park behind. All features are readable.
Fresh light-green young leaves on a small tree, crowded, with a few lobed leaves in the lower centre whose outlines can be traced with study. Young leaves.
A whole wind-bent tree in a dry riverbed under blue sky. Whole-tree photo, so part is other.
Sycamore trunk with the edge in view and a mottled plate pattern. Some shadow falls across it, but the pattern is easy to read.
A herbarium plate of line drawings on a mount, not a photo of a tree. The caption names the species (Platanus racemosa) in readable text, which gives the answer away.

Cracked, flaking bark with warm patchy sun and shadow across it. A bit of trunk curve and background shows at the right edge. The plate pattern is there but a learner has to study it, and the colour is shifted by the light.
Close-up of peeling plates in cream, tan, and grey. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch, or scale, so too_close is true. The patchwork pattern is still clear.
Trunk with both edges in view, showing a mottled pattern of pale and brown peeling plates. Foliage is behind it but the trunk dominates the frame.

Leaning trunk seen from a distance in dappled shade. The bark detail is small in the frame, and the shadows break up the pattern and change the colour. A learner can find the pattern only with close study.

Four dry brown seed balls hang in a string on one stalk against sky and trees. The second ball is a little frayed, which is minor. The balls are soft-textured but the kind, shape, and hang are all readable.
A coloured botanical plate with leaves and seed balls, not a photo of a real tree. The printed species name (Platanus racemosa) is readable at the bottom, which gives the answer away.
A whole old tree with a thick trunk, buttress roots, and spreading limbs over fallen brown leaves. The main subject is the whole tree, so part is other.
A whole tree in full green leaf beside a path, against blue sky. Leaves are seen as a mass, so no leaf or bark feature is the subject and part is other.
Four yellow-green, still spiky seed balls hang on stalks below large leaves. The balls are full shape but not ripe. The leaves around them are busy but the balls stand out.
A whole tree with a forked trunk, mossy base, and exposed roots on a dry slope. The main subject is the tree as a scene, so part is other.
A view up into the crown. Yellowing leaves and many small seed balls blend into a mass, with no single leaf or fruit as the subject. The upward angle is unusual.

Seed balls of mixed colour (green and brown) hang among crowded leaves on a twig against a rocky slope. The leaves and branches compete with the fruit, so alone is false. The brown balls at the centre are the main subject.

Dark rough bark on a big limb with moss and pale succulent rosettes growing on it. The rosettes compete with the bark, and the moss hides the plate pattern, so a learner has to study it. The limb edge is in view.
Close-up of grey, cream, and tan peeling plates. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch, or scale. The patchwork pattern is sharp and clear.
Three green, bristly seed balls hang on stalks among crowded leaves. The balls are full shape but not ripe. The leaves around them compete, so alone is false.

A trunk with both edges in view. A large dark area of rotted or borer-damaged bark with holes covers the middle, which breaks up the plate pattern. A learner can find the pattern only on the lower, intact bark.
A pale, mottled trunk with both edges in view, showing flaking plates. Two dark burls break the surface but the pattern is easy to read.

Four small yellow-green fuzzy balls hang on a long stalk in front of leaves and a fence. The balls look young and not yet full shape, so young is a cause. The leaves behind them are soft and do not compete.

Mottled, peeling cream and olive bark on a large limb, photographed from below with the camera looking up into the crown against sky, with branches and leaves around it. The bark pattern is readable, but the upward view is a reject and counts as an unusual angle.

A sharp, deeply lobed, green palmate leaf in the centre, tilted and partly overlapping another leaf, with bare twigs, other leaves and seed balls around it, so it does not stand alone. The outline and lobe tips read clearly, but the margin and veins are small in the frame and need close study, and the tilt counts as an angle.
A whole small tree with blue-green foliage beside a house. The main subject is the tree, so the part is other.
A whole tree on a lawn beside a stone wall and path. Whole tree or scene, so the part is other.
A whole small tree with leaves blending into a crown mass. The part is other.
A close view of male catkins and bud scales on a twig, with soft out-of-focus leaves behind. The catkins are the main subject, so the part is other.
The camera looks up a trunk into the branch fork and crown, with lichen patches and leaves competing. The ridge pattern is only partly readable, so this is a view into the crown from below.
Hanging catkins and pink new leaf clusters on a twig against a soft background. Flowers are the main subject, so the part is other.
A crown and forked trunk seen from below against the sky. The main subject is the crown, so the part is other.
Overlapping leaves seen from below around a catkin cluster, with several leaves cut by the frame. The outlines and edges can be traced but the crowd and the angle make the learner search.
A twig with pink new leaves and many hanging catkins against a soft background. Flowers dominate, so the part is other.
A new shoot with reddish, hairy young leaves against a plain soft background. The leaves have not reached full shape, so young, and the wavy edge needs a close look.
A woodland scene with a twisted trunk among dense foliage. A scene, so the part is other.
Crowded mature leaves seen from below with a small catkin cluster; the right-hand leaf shows a whole outline and an even edge. The crowding makes the frame busy and the leaves are tilted.
A tree with its trunk and crown beside a stone wall. A whole tree or scene, so the part is other.
A close view of catkins and bud scales with soft leaves behind. Catkins are the main subject, so the part is other.
A dense branch of grey-green leaves that overlap. Individual outlines can be traced only with study, so shape and margin are search and the frame is crowded.
Backlit young leaves on a shoot with warm orange-red tones and a soft dark background. The leaves are not full size and the backlight changes the colour.
A crowded mass of blue-grey leaves, some with several lobes. Leaves overlap and each outline needs close study.
Sharp, mostly green lobed leaves on a twig with autumn-coloured background and a few yellowing leaves. Many leaves share the frame, so the subject is not alone.
A whole dark-leaved tree with a short trunk on a lawn. The part is other.
Part of a crown and trunk with dark leaves, seen from the side. The leaves form a mass and the trunk is not the main subject, so the part is other.

Dim film shot of a leafy branch with two small green acorns. Leaves overlap and sit in a busy background, so outline and edge need study (shape and margin at search, alone false); the twig shows where the stalks join.
Sunlit twig with entire-edged leaves seen from both sides; a thumb at the left edge is not a scale. Several leaves are cut by the frame and overlap, so whole is false and alone is false.
Large oval leaves with a few acorns at centre, taken in dappled light. Leaves dominate the frame so I set part to leaf; they crowd each other (alone false) and the stalk joins are hard to trace.

Dark, slightly dim shot of dull blue-green leaves; the leaf at centre has pronounced lobes unlike the plain oval leaves around it. I treat it as a variant mature form (usual_look false, outline and lobe tips not for testing); leaves crowd, so alone is false.
Dense bluish-grey leaves with entire edges on a branch; the lower right leaf is whole and sharp. The leaves overlap heavily, so alone is false, and the veins are faint.
Branch seen from below against sky and a wall. The leaves are small in the frame and overlap, so outline and edge need close study (search); the view from below is an unusual angle.

Large, deeply lobed green leaves in dappled shade; the centre leaf is whole and the lobes are readable. This is a lobed form, not the typical plain-edged leaf, so I treat it as a variant form (usual_look false); leaves crowd, so alone is false.

Sunlit twig with large entire-edged leaves and dark buds against a blurred lawn; the twig shows where the stalks join. Leaves overlap and the largest ones are cut by the frame, so whole is false and alone is false.
Close view of green acorns with scaly caps among leaves. They are full shape but still green, so unripe and not the usual look; how they sit on the twig is hard to see.

Crown seen from below against sky with the sun at the upper right. The subject is a whole crown with no single leaf, so part is other; the view from below is an unusual angle and the glare and backlight change the colour.
Full-size grey-green oval leaves with entire edges, with old catkins and a small acorn in the upper left (spring sign). Leaves overlap in a busy frame, so alone is false; the lower leaf is whole.

Film shot of a twig with one small acorn and several lobed leaves, with hard shadow patches across the blades that change the colour. Lobed form, not the typical plain leaf, so a variant form; leaves overlap, so alone is false.

Crown seen from below with blue sky and a wall behind it; the leaves are small and dark against the light. The main subject is a crown, so part is other; the view from below is an unusual angle and the backlight darkens the leaves.

Sunlit twig with large entire-edged leaves and dark buds against a blurred lawn; the twig shows where the stalks join. Leaves overlap and the largest ones are cut by the frame, so whole is false and alone is false.
Whole trunk in a woodland scene, with grey blocky plates and shallow grooves that repeat across the trunk. The trunk edge and the ground are in the frame, so it is not too close.
Bare twig with green catkins and tiny red new leaves against a soft background. Catkins and new shoots are the subject, not a full leaf, so part is other; the red colour is natural new growth.
Sharp view of green acorns with scaly caps among leaves; a leaf at the front covers part of the frame. Sharp leaves around the acorns compete with them (alone false); fruit is green, so unripe.
Film close view of a trunk with small blocky plates and the trunk edge on the right. Hard sun and deep shadow on the left side change the colour, so I set light.
Trunk in front of a lawn, with grey-brown scaly plates and a patch of green lichen at the centre. Both trunk edges show, and the plate pattern is readable.

Dense mass of orange, russet and green autumn leaves filling the frame. Individual leaves can be traced with study but they crowd and overlap (alone false, shape and margin at search); autumn colour is not a cause.

Several green, entire-margined leaves crowd the frame with a male catkin in the middle; the catkin does not replace the leaves. Crowding gives alone false, and the twig junction is only partly visible so arrangement is search. Catkin marks spring.
A whole small tree on a rocky slope with other trees behind. The main subject is none of leaf, bark, or fruit, so part is other.
A wide trunk view with grey, blocky, scaly plates and furrows. Both trunk edges are in view, so it is not too close. The ground behind does not compete with the trunk.

Crowded green leaves on a twig, held by a hand at the bottom. The leaves are lobed, unlike the entire oblong form in other photos of this tree, so I treated this as a variant form; if the source does not name a lobed form it would be a sucker leaf. A pale blotch on the lower leaf does not change the outline.

Lobed blue-green leaves on a twig held in a hand, with three small white woolly galls hanging from the twig. The upper-left leaf shows its full outline. Leaves are crowded, and the lobed form is not the typical entire form here, so I treated it as a variant form (a sucker leaf if the source does not name it).

A cluster of broad lobed green leaves on a twig, with a hand behind at the left. The top leaf is whole and clear, but other leaves overlap it, so alone is false. The lobed form differs from the typical entire leaf, so I treated it as a variant form.
A scene of a leaning trunk and canopy on a rocky slope. Leaves and bark are both small and not the subject, so part is other.

Many entire-margined green leaves on a twig shot from below against blue sky, with a small acorn at the centre. The upward angle and overlapping leaves make it harder. The twig shows where the stalks join, so arrangement is clear.
One oblong, entire, slightly wavy leaf seen from the underside, held in a hand. The fingers cover the base of the leaf, so whole is false. The background is soft and the leaf is the main subject.

A green acorn whose nut tip just shows in a scaly cap, seen end-on from the front on a twig. It is not mature (young) and the end-on view hides its outline (angle), so shape is search. The cap and the way it sits on the twig are clear.
One oblong, nearly entire dark-green leaf seen from the underside, held by fingers; the fingers do not cover the outline. The background is soft and the leaf is the main subject.

A forked, twisting grey trunk with ridged and furrowed bark, seen from below at a distance. The ridges are small in the frame, so texture and pattern are search. Branches, a dead limb, and foliage compete with the trunk.

Broad green leaves in a crowd with hanging catkins below them, which mark spring. Light shines through some leaves and turns them yellow-green, which changes the colour (light). The leaves overlap, so alone is false.

Acorns on a twig with scaly caps: one green, one brown, one brown nut in a cap. They are at mixed ripeness, mostly browning, which suggests autumn. Spotted leaves and a dark object at the right edge compete with the acorns, so alone is false.

A dense group of deeply lobed green leaves seen from above. Single leaves can be traced, so I did not call it a mass, but the crowding gives alone false. The lobed form differs from the typical entire leaf, so I treated it as a variant form (a sucker leaf if the source does not name it).
A thin trunk and branches seen through dense foliage. The bark is too small and the leaves too blended to be the subject, so I called it a scene (other).
A twig with several small entire green leaves against a dark soft background. The alternate leaf stalks join the twig in view, so arrangement is clear. Leaf veins are small and need a close look.

One large broad leaf in the foreground, seen from below and lit from behind against the sky, so it glows yellow-green (angle and light). Its base blends into leaves at the top edge, so whole is false. The edge is only roughly readable.
A whole tree and crown on a rocky hillside with other shrubs. The subject is none of leaf, bark, or fruit, so part is other.
Flowers and catkins on a twig tip are the main subject, with leaves only around them. Flowers alone are part other.

A full-size green acorn with a scaly cap, held up behind a twig with a hand and leaves around it. The acorn is whole and unripe, so usual_look is false. The hand and leaves compete, so alone is false, and the hang is only found with study.

A branch crowded with leaves and many green acorns, mostly small in the frame. Several acorns at lower left show whole, but the shape and cap need a search among the leaves, so alone is false. The acorns are green and unripe.

Several overlapping green lobed leaves, upper side. The large leaf at right shows its outline and lobed edge, but the other leaves crowd it, so alone is false. A few small brown spots do not change the outline.
A large, sharp, full-size green acorn with a scaly cap, in front of soft leaves. The acorn is the main subject and is whole. It is unripe, and the hang on the twig is only partly visible.

Overlapping blue-green leaves on a sunlit branch with a small yellow-green cluster at the centre. The leaf at upper centre is mostly whole with a readable outline and edge. The other leaves crowd it, so alone is false.

Two large green acorns with scaly caps sit at the centre of the frame, with lobed leaves behind them. They are sharp and whole and are the main subject. They are unripe, and the twig attachment is partly hidden.

A leafy branch with several small green acorns, seen from a distance with rocky ground behind. The acorns are small in the frame and mixed with leaves, so each fruit feature is at search and alone is false. The acorns are unripe.
A cluster of green acorns with scaly caps on a twig, sharp and close, with a large leaf behind. The acorns show their shape, caps and attachment, and they are the main subject. They are unripe.

A twig tip with leaves tilted at different angles against the sky, showing both the upper side and the grey-green underside. The leaves overlap and are foreshortened, and the frame edge cuts some of them, so the outline and edge need study. The tilt is the angle cause.

A grey trunk with scaly, blocky plates, taken from a few metres away so both trunk edges show. The surface is readable, but the plate pattern needs some study at this distance. The background is busy but the trunk dominates.
Trunk and branches seen from below into a leafy crown; the main subject is the whole tree and crown, so part is other. The upward view is an unusual angle.
A wide scene of a tree with Spanish moss on a lawn, with the sun in the frame and a deep shadow on the grass; no leaf, bark or fruit is the subject. Strong sun glare changes the light.
One sharp, whole green lobed leaf against a soft background; the outline and lobes read clearly. The twig is only partly shown at the bottom, so the arrangement needs a search.
Small immature acorns, mostly covered by their scaly caps, on a twig in soft focus. The fruit has not reached full shape and is small in the frame, so kind and shape need close study.
Close view of rough, irregularly plated and furrowed bark with brown and grey tones. The frame shows texture only: no trunk edge, branch or scale object.
A trunk section with both edges in the frame; the bark is grey-brown with small blocky plates and fissures, sharp and well lit.
A view up into a leafy crown: the leaves blend into a mass with branches and sky, so no leaf, bark or fruit is the subject. The upward angle is unusual.
A sharp green lobed leaf in side view on its twig, with softer leaves around it. The outline and lobes are clear; the lateral veins are faint and need a search.
Two whole leaves on black: the upper side of a lobed leaf with a few red spots, and the paler underside of a narrower leaf. Outlines and veins are clear; the spots do not change the outline.

A tight crop of two overlapping leaf pieces, upper side left and underside right, cut by the frame. The outline and lobes are not shown, so shape is no and the margin shows only along a short stretch.
One whole green lobed leaf in the centre, sharp against a soft background, with other leaves beside it. Shape, lobes and veins read clearly; the stalk join on the twig is only partly shown.
A whole trunk width with both edges in view; grey, finely plated and fissured bark with soft leaves at the side. Sharp and well lit.
A bare twig segment with two buds and leaf stalks on a black background; the main subject is the twig and buds, not a leaf, bark or fruit.
The pale underside of a lobed leaf, cropped by the top and bottom of the frame. The margin and veins are clear, but the full outline is cut off, so the shape needs study.
A leafy branch against a bright sky with a few small brown acorns in the middle; the leaves blend into a mass and the acorns are too small to read. The subject is the branch, not one part.
Two whole leaves on black: a lobed upper side with red lesions and an unlobed underside. Outlines and veins are sharp; the lesions do not change the outline.
A park scene with a tall tree hung with Spanish moss, a lawn, a shelter and a place sign (not a plant label). No leaf, bark or fruit is the subject.
One whole acorn of full shape with a scaly cap and a green nut, still unripe, on its twig against black. Kind, shape and cap are clear.
A twig tip with a cluster of buds and leaf stalks on black; the main subject is the buds, so part is other.
One whole green lobed leaf with its stalk near the twig, against a soft background with other leaves at the edges. Outline, lobes and veins are clear.

Large green leaf tilted toward the camera against a soft background. The frame edge cuts the lower-left side of the leaf, so whole is false, and the tilt and cut-off make the outline and margin a search. Angle is a cause for the tilt.
Dark, shaded leaves crowd the frame with a trunk behind them, and one central leaf shows its whole outline. Deep shade darkens the colour (light) and the crowding makes the shape and margin a search.
Wide view of a mature trunk with small blocky grey plates and pale lichen blotches. Both trunk edges show, so the pattern repeat is readable.
A dead brown lobed leaf lying in leaf litter with many similar leaves around it, so it does not stand alone. The subject is a dead leaf, so it is a reject.

Several overlapping large green leaves on a twig, with a fingertip at the bottom edge and a trunk behind. One central leaf shows its whole lobed outline, but the crowding makes the margin and leaf attachment a search.
Small green-and-tan young acorns with knobby caps sit on a green twig against a soft background. They have not reached full shape, so the kind and outline need close study (young).
A whole tall tree in a scene with a person standing at the lower right for scale. The main subject is the whole tree, so the part is other.

An acorn cut across, seen end-on as a green disc with a scaly brown cup rim on a black background. It is not the typical whole-fruit form and the view is unusual, so the kind and cap need close study.
Backlit branches against a pale sky with a few small brown and green autumn leaves. No single leaf is the subject, so the part is other.

A hand at the upper left holds a twig with several overlapping green leaves, and a trunk shows behind. The central leaves show their outline, but the crowding makes the margin and stalk joins a search.
Whole base of an old trunk with deep dark ridges and furrows, with a thin vine crossing it. Both trunk edges show.
Backlit branches and a few brown autumn leaves against a pale sky, with no single leaf as the subject. The part is other.
A view up into a sunlit green crown with the leaves blended together and a trunk at the lower edge. The part is other.
A dark backlit branch silhouette against cloudy sky, seen from below. The leaves are a mass and no leaf outline is readable, so the part is other.
A cluster of small young acorns with knobby tan caps sit on a green twig against a soft background. They have not reached full shape, so the kind and outline need close study (young).
A whole tree trunk and crown seen from directly below. The subject is the whole tree, so the part is other.
A pale brown dead leaf with soft edges in leaf litter with other fallen leaves. The subject is a dead leaf, so it is a reject.
A leafy branch with many small lobed green leaves against blue sky. The leaves overlap and are small in the frame, so the outline and margin of any one leaf need a search.
A wide trunk of rough grey bark with pale lichen patches, with the left trunk edge showing. The lichen blotches blur the ridge and plate pattern, so it needs a search.
A view up a trunk into bare branches with a few leaves, moss and backlight. The subject is the crown and branches, so the part is other.
Mossy trunk in dappled shade with edges and background visible. Moss and shade hide the furrows, so texture, pattern and colour need close study, and light is a cause.
Sharp trunk with grey scaly ridges and furrows, some moss, trunk edges in frame. Texture and pattern read easily.
Dead brown leaves scattered on soil and litter beside a stone edge. The leaves are small, crowded and mixed with debris, and the subject is dead leaves.
Trunk with vertical ridges and flaky plates, a little moss, trunk edges and soft foliage behind. Surface and colour are clear.
Woodland scene with a person reaching up to a branch beside a log. The main subject is a scene, not a leaf, bark or fruit.
Seven dry brown leaves laid on a board beside a ruler. Their outlines show clearly, but they are dead leaves, and the warm lamp light and shadows add a light cause.
Crown of a large tree seen from below against the sky. The main subject is a whole tree, so the part is other.
Several toothed leaves on a twig, tilted and overlapping, with a hand at the top edge. The frame cuts off leaves and the crowding makes outline and edge need close study.

Large lobed leaves seen from above on a log, overlapping and cut by the frame. Lobes and margin show, but the outline of one leaf needs study. The vigorous growth may be a sprout, but the source does not say so.
Cluster of lobed leaves seen from above on a log with litter behind. Lobes are readable, but leaves overlap and the frame cuts some off, and the view is from above.
